fomod.Name: Zenderal - Enemy Potions
fomod.Author: Zenderal
fomod.Description:
Enderal puts potions on citizens, not on enemies. Its main potion list is referenced by eight NPC records, seven of which are dead-body props, and the one properly level-banded potion list SureAI wrote sits exclusively on townsfolk, guards and dancers as pickpocket loot. Potions are an alchemist purchase, never a combat reward.
This patch adds a level-banded restore-health / restore-mana / restore-stamina drop to the three leveled lists Enderal's enemies actually share, reaching every bandit tier and every Lost One - 353 enemy records in all. Roughly a third of those enemies drop one potion, of a tier appropriate to your level.
Nothing is taken away. Each list is restructured so the original loot resolves exactly as before and the potion roll happens independently alongside it, using the same "use all" nesting Enderal already uses for its own smoking-pipe and draugr-weapon loot.
ESL-flagged, nine records, no scripts. Masters Skyrim.esm and Enderal - Forgotten Stories.esm.
